SELECT f.channel_id, s.format, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS n_receipts, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id||'-'||f.store_key) AS rcpt_store, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS n_stores, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badq, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS n_days
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH l AS (SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.format FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30' AND f.channel_id=1),
r AS (SELECT receipt_id, store_id, format, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT line_no) AS dn, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines, sum(net_amount) AS net, count(DISTINCT sale_date) AS nd FROM l GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT 'dup_lineno' k, count(*) v FROM r WHERE n<>dn
UNION ALL SELECT 'mixed_staff', count(*) FROM r WHERE staff_lines>0 AND staff_lines<n
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff_receipts', count(*) FROM r WHERE staff_lines=n
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_date', count(*) FROM r WHERE nd>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'tz_mismatch', count(*) FROM l WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) <> sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'ts_outside_period_utc', count(*) FROM l WHERE sale_ts_utc < '2026-08-03' OR sale_ts_utc >= '2026-08-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'small_net_receipts_lt1', count(*) FROM r WHERE net<1
UNION ALL SELECT 'max_net_receipt', max(net) FROM r
UNION ALL SELECT 'ltsales_noreceipt_store', count(*) FROM l WHERE store_id IS NULL

calls.statement: SELECT sale_date, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS n_receipts, sum(net_amount) AS net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-01' AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, s.format, bool_and(f.staff_purchase_flag) AS is_staff, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND f.channel_id = 1 AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id, s.format)
SELECT format,
  round(sum(net) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_staff) / count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_staff), 2) AS atv_net_excl_staff,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_staff) AS rcpts_excl_staff,
  round(sum(net) / count(*), 2) AS atv_net_incl_staff,
  count(*) AS rcpts_all,
  round(sum(gross) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_staff) / count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_staff), 2) AS atv_gross_excl_staff,
  min(net) AS min_net
FROM r GROUP BY format ORDER BY format
